AUDIT_CHECKS_PARAGRAPH.formatted: **Audit checks (protocol §6; reported only, DEVIATIONS Entry 2).** AQ1 passed: each of the 112 brand units had a row in the domain list; 0 were unresolved and 5 had no own domain (the defunct brands). AQ2: the home page returned status 200 for 77 of the 107 brands with an own domain (0.720), **below 0.80, so the audit is flagged**; of the other home pages, 23 were blocked by the site and 7 were not requested because the site's `robots.txt` could not be read (server error or timeout). SDRI was therefore not rated for 30 of the 107 (28%), above the 0.20 at which protocol §5 flags this share (flagged); they enter H7 only through the SDRI$_{\text{kg}}$ sensitivity below. AQ3: pass 1 parsed 195 pages holding 233 JSON-LD blocks, of which 0 failed to parse. AQ4: pass 2 re-fetched the home page only, once, starting 2026-11-22 18:11 UTC, 9 days 11 hours after pass 1 began. The date the protocol sets (7 days after pass 1 began) fell inside the period without requests, so pass 2 ran after that period ended (DEVIATIONS Entry 16). Of the 77 brands whose home page was fetched in both passes, 0 (0%) changed in indicators (1)--(5) read from the home page alone. Pass 2 enters no verdict: Stage C2 had already run on pass 1.

S_KG_SENTENCE.formatted: Beside H7, the sensitivity named in protocol §5 (DEVIATIONS Entry 1) correlates SDRI$_{\text{kg}}$ (indicators (6)--(8) alone) with G\*, including brands whose home page could not be fetched: across 42 brands in 5 categories, $\rho_w(\text{SDRI}_{\text{kg}}, G^*) = -0.035$ (90% interval -0.304 to 0.261; one-sided $p = 0.5844$). Under H7's bands this reads FALSIFIED; it is a sensitivity, reported beside H7 and never a verdict, and H7 stays **UNDETERMINED**.
